decisions.reason: As a full aloe vera line with its own dedicated page in both years, it represents the firm's largest and most visible investment among the new products, so management is committed to it and would explain any weak results as temporary.

The serum is a single, low-investment item that is only mentioned on the website, but it has stayed listed for two years, fits the core facial care range well, and costs little to keep in a small-batch operation.

Launched only in 2024 and only mentioned on the website, it has had too little time to show results, and it likely fills the gap left by the discontinued cleansing milk, so management would keep it while attributing any slow start to its recent launch.
